title: draft-upsert response
description: warnings may include SLUG_MISMATCH {wanted, got} (Phase 1 cannot set a slug on create); v1.5.7: SEO_LIVE_REFUSED {fields} (seo.* not written on a live entry, §33.5), DRAFT_HASH_UNAVAILABLE.

idempotentReplay.description: v1.0.1: true on a response replayed from the idempotency store (EmDash strips the X-AOS-Idempotent-Replay header)

draftRevisionId.description: EmDash draft revision id, or v<version> (e.g. v1) for a never-published entry whose main row is the draft. Opaque.

rev.description: Opaque concurrency token: compare for equality only; send back as baseRev

revision.description: v1.5.7 (§33.4): the same value as rev (name used by the SEO Engine: { entryId, revision, draftHash })

anyOf.description: v1.5.7 (§33.4): hash of the draft as stored after this write; null only with warning DRAFT_HASH_UNAVAILABLE

v1.5.8 (§34.1): everything draftHash covers except the content value, exactly as hashed (the same object as entry-get editable.hashBasis); { v: 1, ...hashBasis, content: { format, value } } hashes to draftHash. Absent from sites below 1.5.8; null only with warning DRAFT_HASH_UNAVAILABLE

entry.description: v1.2.0: the entry summary after the save (same shape as inventory)
